name: musc-gpu
timing_scope: MuSc.make_category_data entry through synchronized pre-metric predictions; includes loading, decoding, preprocessing, transfers, encoding, aggregation, scoring, interpolation, RsCIN and first-use compilation; excludes imports, model loading, metric evaluation and artifact serialization
protocol: fresh process per trial, no discarded image warmup, alternating paired order
filesystem_cache: OS filesystem cache is not flushed; cold process is not cold storage

workloads.manifest_definition: SHA256 of ordered relative image paths and byte sizes; not image-content hashes

original.scope: MuSc.make_category_data entry through synchronized pre-metric predictions; includes loading, decoding, preprocessing, transfers, encoding, aggregation, scoring, interpolation, RsCIN and first-use compilation; excludes imports, model loading, metric evaluation and artifact serialization

metrics.definition: upstream resized masks and predictions; threshold-maximized F1; upstream PRO at FPR<0.3

processes.Name: powershell.exe
processes.CommandLine: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'python|powershell|pwsh|ollama|llama|qwen' } | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine) | ConvertTo-Json -Compress"
